kind: Preserved manual timestamp-causality controls. No unit disk fixtures or product runtime behavior changes.

minimal.kind: Minimal synchronous native-only fixture. No source content read between ancient utimes and native launch in no-read/read-then-reset profiles. Metadata-only source AND target snapshots immediately before and after launch, before all content verification. reset-then-read is an intentional positive control for harness-induced atime change.

launch.kind: Native launch causality controls; no source reads between utimes and invocation. Metadata-only snapshots.

delay.kind: No-process delay and launch controls; waits before resetting timestamps versus no-settle controls. No content reads after utimes before metadata snapshots.
